verdict.rationale: FreshBooks publishes an official Node.js SDK under its own GitHub org that gets and sets data via the REST API. Its API docs include a 'Getting Started with FreshBooks NodeJS SDK' tutorial and a Tools and Libraries page, so the core story is delivered first-party. missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs in languages beyond Node.js, detailed SDK reference documentation or coverage of the API surface, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Get/set data from FreshBooks using the REST API.
